# Day 28 — Delivery capacity and support boundaries (INTERNAL)

**Evidence status:** policy and scenario model, not signed SLA or observed delivery performance. Do not publish internal assumptions or imply real customers.

## Start / scope

- The first paid step is Process Analysis (TRY 4,900 or separate USD list 149). Pilot is TRY 24,900 / independent USD 750. Monthly management starts TRY 14,900 / independent USD 449.
- The clock can start only after written scope, billing/tax/payment channel, authorized human owner, permitted inputs and required access are confirmed.
- A "24-hour" public target on the Process Analysis page is an aspiration after gates are satisfied, not guaranteed response or completion SLA.
- Sales promises of 24/7 support, one-hour resolution, guaranteed uptime, unlimited fixes, or external certification are prohibited without contracted and proven capacity.

## Tier boundaries

| Tier | Delivery | Default support |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Process Analysis | Problem framing, evidence of 3–10 observations if applicable, risk/priority and 7-day implementation plan | Delivery questions scoped in signed offer; no live production support |
| Controlled Pilot | One defined workflow, explicit test/acceptance cases, rollback and human ownership | Pilot-only observation and incident handling; durations and channels agreed in writing |
| Monthly Management | Agreed monitoring cadence, documented incident severity, change budget and monthly review | No unlimited new feature, external connector, out-of-hours monitoring or response time by default |

## Escalation

1. Pause or restrict high-risk actions if approvals, access scope, or data boundaries fail.
2. Record incident ID, observed impact, time, current owner, manual fallback and evidence link.
3. Escalate to designated human owner using explicitly contracted channel and timetable.
4. Reopen only after regression and acceptance tests pass and the human owner approves.

## Hard capacity gate

Before accepting each monthly client, calculate available monthly labor hours after existing support and reserve. When weekly capacity, risk, or incident load is unmeasured, **do not** commit to a fixed SLA. For recurring plans use a written maximum change budget and review the contribution margin at current assumed cost.

## Public disclosure

Describe boundaries in normal buyer language, without internal financial data or implied production outcome. Never publish platform traffic, conversion, pipeline or private strategy numbers.
